description:
Clean develop gave 93 local unit failures, many from environment coupling. Fix at source:
1. Enumerate Path.cwd()/os.getcwd() repo-root assumptions in tests (grep -rnE "Path\.cwd\(\)|os\.getcwd\(\)" tests) and derive repo root from the test file location (one shared helper).
2. Tests must not read the real home directory (~/.benchbox) or wall clock; inject them.
3. Replace process-global mutable state (benchbox.utils.printing _QUIET, utils.config_interface provider) with injection where practical; keep the autouse reset fixtures in tests/conftest.py as a safety net.
4. Add an autouse leak detector that fails a test only when cwd, os.environ, or registered globals differ after teardown. Tests that legitimately chdir (e.g. tests/unit/generators/test_tpch_generator.py:910) must restore via fixture and pass.
